trustedSourceSummary: Exact official tests for "passata di pomodoro" were not available in 2025-2026, so the broader official category "passata" was used. No official consumer documents were found in the last 60 days, so the latest available official sources from 2025-2026 were used. Organizations used: Altroconsumo. Altroconsumo's 2025 laboratory tests recommend DE CECCO and DE RICA as top passata brands, noting they contain real passata, no added water, and offer good taste and value. The evidence is fresh (published June 2025).
